item.title: US flights grounded nationwide after air traffic control outage
item.description: All departures across the United States were halted for more than four hours on Friday after a communications failure hit air traffic control centres. Thousands of flights were cancelled or delayed. The transport secretary blamed ageing technology.

item.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to former diocese in Peru
item.description: Pope Leo XIV returned to Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for eight years. Vatican News said about half a million people attended an open-air Mass. He told the crowd it was a joy to be home.

item.title: Nvidia boss Jensen Huang resigns amid spy affair scandal
item.description: Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive of Nvidia after admitting an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The chip giant's finance chief Colette Kress will lead the company on an interim basis.

item.title: Israel says it targeted senior Hamas commander in Gaza strike
item.description: The Israeli military said it struck a senior member of Hamas's armed wing in Gaza. Hamas sources said the commander was killed. The strike comes amid a fragile ceasefire.
